text: Hey Allie — passing something on from Jordan. He told me things between him and Sarah have been a bit awkward lately, and for now he'd rather not see her outside of work. He asked me to let you know since you're usually the one hosting get-togethers.

Thanks for the heads-up, Dana. I'll keep it in mind for the next get-together — I won't put those two in a small thing together. Since it came secondhand, I'll check with Jordan himself before I change any plans.
Makes sense — checking with him directly is the right call. Talk soon.

Hi Allie! Random idea — would you want to host a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? It'd be nice to get people together. Would you invite Jordan too? Just as your own idea, though — I'd rather you didn't mention me at all. Things have been a bit awkward between us lately and I don't want him to feel it's about me.
Saturday 3:30 works for me — my afternoon is free, so I can host. Let me check one thing on my calendar and I'll come back to you in a minute.
Great, thank you! Just let me know when you've checked.
Almost there — checking the calendar now.

Checked — Saturday is free for me, so let's do it: my place, Saturday 3:30. It's on my calendar now.

I'll invite a few people myself, Jordan included. Don't worry about how he'll read it — it'll just be a normal get-together at mine, and I'll say it's my idea because it is. I'll let you know who's coming.
Perfect, thanks Allie — Saturday 3:30 at yours it is. Let me know who's coming.

Hi Jordan! I'm hosting a small get-together at my place this Saturday, 3:30 — nothing formal, just people from the department and something to eat. Would you like to come?

So you know who'll be there: Sarah is coming, and I'm asking Dana too. No pressure either way — say yes and I'll count you in.

Hi Dana! Small get-together at my place this Saturday, 3:30 — nothing fancy, just department people and food. Come?

(Sarah and Jordan are both invited, so you'll know everyone there.)

Hi Allie, thanks for thinking of me — that's really kind. I'm going to sit this one out, though. Things with Sarah have been a bit awkward lately and I'd rather not be around her socially for now; nothing against her, and nothing to do with you. I'd love to see you another time — maybe just the two of us, a coffee or lunch soon? And have a good time on Saturday either way.

Totally fine, Jordan — no explanation needed, and thanks for telling me straight. I won't push on Saturday.

Lunch the two of us sounds good. My Tuesday and Wednesday next week (24th, 25th) are free at noon — want to say 12:00 on Tuesday the 24th? I'll put it in my calendar once you confirm.

Jordan's out for Saturday — he'd rather not be around you socially just now, he said, and it's nothing to do with me or with the plan. So it'll be a smaller group.

Dana's invited, waiting to hear back. Want me to ask anyone else from the department?
No worries — a smaller group sounds nice actually. Invite whoever you feel like, I'm easy. Thanks for sorting it out!
No rush on the answer — just let me know by Friday so I know how much food to get.

Tuesday the 24th doesn't work for me, sorry — my weekdays are booked straight through during the day, and I keep those for work. My free time is the weekend. Are you around Sunday the 22nd? 13:00 would suit me well (boxing off the whole afternoon after that). If that's no good, another weekend slot works too.
Sunday the 22nd at 13:00 works — it's on my calendar now (13:00-14:30, so your afternoon after that is untouched). Where suits you? Happy to come to your side of campus.
Yes, count me in — Saturday 3:30 at your place, on my calendar. I'll bring something to eat. Thanks for hosting!
Great — Sunday the 22nd, 13:00-14:30, it's in mine too. Let's meet at the café on the Ave (the one near the corner with 45th) unless you'd rather somewhere else; I'm easy. See you then!
Perfect — you're counted in. Bring whatever you like; I'll have the main food and drinks covered. See you Saturday at 3:30.
The café on the Ave is perfect. Sunday the 22nd at 13:00, see you there — and good luck with the rest of your week.
Perfect — see you Sunday at 13:00. Thanks, Allie, and good week to you too!
